whatItIs.headline: A co-creative space for people who make things.
whatItIs.body: ODDspace is a workspace and event space in Vallila for people working across art, culture, design, media, technology, business and other creative fields. Under one roof there are places to work, meet, record, exhibit, talk and host events. The point is not only to share square metres, but to make it easier for different kinds of work and people to cross paths. It is still a pilot, and the people using it help shape what it becomes.

coCreative.headline: Working next to each other is useful. Working with each other is the point.
coCreative.body: ODDspace is designed so people can do their own work without being forced into “community”, while making collaboration unusually easy when it is useful. Different practices share the same rooms; work in progress can be shown, questions can be asked, someone can be pulled into a project, and an idea can turn into an event or collaboration. By co-creative, we mean a place where independent work and shared making can exist side by side.

networkBeyondRoom.headline: The network should be bigger than the room.
networkBeyondRoom.body: Not everyone who should be part of ODDspace needs a permanent desk. The wider network around the space can include people who come through events, projects, collaborations and open sessions — people who want to stay close to what is happening and contribute when there is a reason to. The physical space is the anchor. It should not be the boundary.

community.headline: Different practices. Same roof — and a wider network around it.
community.body: ODDspace is for people working across art, design, music, media, writing, production, entrepreneurship, technology, research and other creative practices. Some use the space day to day. Others can come through events, projects and collaborations. You do not need to fit one professional label. The useful part is having enough overlap for conversations, shared work and new ideas to start.

eventEnquiry.headline: Want to organise an event?
eventEnquiry.body: Have an exhibition, workshop, talk, screening, launch, performance, gathering, shoot or another idea you want to make happen here? You do not need to be a member to ask.

vision.headline: Creative work needs somewhere to continue.
vision.body: Too much creative work starts and stops with individual projects, productions and funding cycles. A place cannot solve that on its own, but it can change the rhythm: somewhere people can return to, keep working, see the same faces again and let ideas develop for longer than one project. ODDspace is our current experiment in that. The bigger question is what kind of permanent, useful infrastructure Finland could build around its creative and cultural fields over time.

faq.question: What is ODDspace?
faq.answer: A co-creative workspace and event space in Vallila, Helsinki with coworking areas, meeting rooms, an event/gallery floor, an auditorium and an audio/podcast studio. “Co-creative” means people can work independently while the space also makes it easier to share work, ask for input and collaborate when useful.

faq.question: Do I need to be a physical member to be part of ODDspace?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Day-to-day workspace access is a membership product, but ODDspace also has events, projects and collaborations that involve people outside the physical member base.

faq.question: How do I become a member?
faq.answer: Apply through the membership enquiry link on this page, with a note on how you'd like to use the space. Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis as space becomes available during the pilot.

faq.question: What does membership cost?
faq.answer: €150 per month, one flat rate — no tiers.

faq.question: What's included in membership?
faq.answer: Full, 24/7 access to the co-working space, shared facilities and meeting rooms, plus member rates on bookable event spaces.

faq.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No — it's a flexible monthly membership with no long-term commitment during the pilot phase.

faq.question: Can I visit before joining?
faq.answer: Yes — mention it in your message and we'll set up a time to show you around.

faq.question: Can non-members organise events?
faq.answer: Yes. Renting the gallery or auditorium doesn't require membership — get in touch with what you have in mind.

faq.question: What kinds of events can happen there?
faq.answer: Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots, gatherings, performances and showcases have all happened in the space.

faq.question: What spaces are available?
faq.answer: Co-working space, an event/gallery floor, an auditorium and an audio/podcast studio.

faq.question: How much does event use cost?
faq.answer: Member rates: €200 for a full day in the 1st floor gallery, €100 for a half day in the auditorium. Non-member rates are set case by case — get in touch.

faq.question: How do I enquire about an event?
faq.answer: Use the event enquiry link on this page and tell us what you have in mind — you don't need to be a member first.

faq.question: Is ODDspace accessible?
faq.answer: If accessibility is a factor for your visit, get in touch before you come and we'll make sure it works.
